title: Department of Energy manages UFO secrecy and crash retrievals

tellings.quote: think and kind of know that the Department of Energy has a lot to do with managing UFO secrecy and crash retrievals.

plain: A podcast host named Jesse Michels says that he thinks, and in a sense knows, that the Department of Energy, the US government agency that runs nuclear weapons work and the national science labs, plays a large part in keeping UFOs secret. He says it also helps manage what he calls crash retrievals, meaning the recovery of crashed craft of unknown origin. If true, this would place a civilian science agency at the center of the UFO cover-up.
